class.name: FilmGrainEffect
class.brief_description: Fine noise over the picture, as on film.
class.description: Fine noise over the picture that changes every frame, strongest in the mid and dark tones, as on film. Add it to a [Compositor]'s [member Compositor.compositor_effects], on a [WorldEnvironment] or [Camera3D]. It's drawn after the scene's see-through objects, before tonemapping, in each view (both eyes in VR), with the Forward+ renderer; with the others it draws nothing.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], each color channel has its own grain; otherwise the grain is the same in each, as on black-and-white film.
The size of a grain, in pixels.
